# MT Messe Stand
> Exhibition stand design and construction company in Istanbul, Turkey.

## About
MT Messe Stand provides custom wooden, Octanorm, Maxima & modular exhibition stands. Turn-key service from design to dismantling worldwide. 300+ stands built across 28+ countries.

## WHERE WE WORK
We design, manufacture and install custom exhibition stands worldwide. With our own factory in Istanbul and trusted logistics network, we deliver turn-key booths across Europe, the Middle East and beyond.

- Istanbul — Turkey (Headquarters & Factory)
- Dubai — UAE [TBD]
- Moscow — Russia [TBD]

## HOW WE WORK
1. **Discovery & Quote** — You share your fair details, m², stand type and budget. We send a tailored proposal within 48 hours.
2. **3D Design & Approval** — Our designers create a custom 3D render of your stand. You review, request changes, and approve.
3. **Production & Logistics** — We manufacture in our Istanbul factory, handle all shipping and customs, and transport to the fair venue.
4. **Installation & Support** — Our team sets up your stand before the fair opens. A dedicated Junior Assistant-Mate stays with you throughout the event.

## Services
- Custom Wooden Stands: Premium construction tailored to brand
- Maxima Modular Stands: Cost-effective, modern look
- Octanorm Modular Stands: Best for limited budgets
- Enhancing Package Stands: Transform standard booths
- Country Pavilion Solutions: Complete pavilion design
- Turn-key Exhibitor Services: Furniture, hostesses, catering, logistics
